why:
I compared each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2 and 5 test only what their lines require. Three checks ask for more:
- **Check 6:** PASS requires "there is one open PR on that repo". Expect line 6 says only "one PR … whose body says Closes …". It never says the PR must be open, so a merged PR would wrongly fail.
- **Check 3:** PASS requires "stderr must name missing.jsonl". The expect line only asks for an "error on stderr".
- **Check 4:** PASS also requires that `lint.test.js` passes. Expect line 4 only says lint(text) is unchanged.

These stricter tests are inside PASS conditions rather than under Advisory, so the criterion fails.
